title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.
